primary_output_claim: AI agents can reliably perform end-to-end computational reproduction from real physics papers, correctly implementing the reported method and recovering the paper's quantitative results.
validator_anchor: Abstract and Introduction; Section 3, Benchmark Construction (domain-expert reference implementations and independent verification by a second domain expert); Section 4, Evaluation
validator_rationale: The benchmark authors commissioned the references, so institutional externality is not established; however, evaluated agents cannot adapt to the verified ground truth, and a second domain expert independently checks each task's method, implementation, and physical behavior.
endpoint_anchor: Abstract and Introduction; Section 3, Benchmark Construction; Section 4, Evaluation (methodology understanding, code correctness, data reproduction accuracy, and task completion)
endpoint_rationale: The reference implementation and verified numerical ground truth directly test the claimed end-to-end reproduction, while method agreement, code correctness, reproduced quantities, and physical plausibility cover its central failure conditions.

primary_output_claim: VERITAS can autonomously carry out end-to-end hypothesis testing on medical-imaging data and produce statistically correct, power-aware, auditable Supported, Refuted, Underpowered, or Invalid conclusions.
validator_anchor: Introduction and Contributions; Section 3.4, Benchmark & Evaluation (canonical reference statistics computed from ground-truth masks and metadata, validated by a domain expert)
validator_rationale: The decisive reference statistics and their expert validation are described, but the paper does not document an external institution, blinded or held-out evaluator, independent reproduction, or another adequate separation from the author team.
endpoint_anchor: Introduction and Contributions; Sections 3.3-3.4, Evidence Label Framework and Benchmark & Evaluation
endpoint_rationale: Canonical dataset-derived statistics are compared directly with the system's verdicts and mechanically derived evidence labels; positive, negative/no-effect, underpowered, and untestable controls test the conclusion and its central statistical failure conditions.

primary_output_claim: AI agents can conduct long-horizon analysis of raw or near-raw spatial-biology data and experimental context, without a prescribed method, to recover correct complex scientific conclusions.
validator_anchor: Abstract; Figure 2 and Benchmark Design (independent reanalysis, randomized expert review, trajectory inspection, anonymized data, and controlled answer surfaces)
validator_rationale: Institutional externality is not documented, but candidate claims are independently reproduced and randomly peer-reviewed before evaluation, and agents receive anonymized data while decisive answers are fixed behind controlled grading procedures.
endpoint_anchor: Abstract; Introduction; Benchmark Design; Endpoint grading (deterministic grading of the final structured scientific answer)
endpoint_rationale: The scored endpoint is the target biological conclusion itself, not merely workflow execution; reproduction and review reject unstable claims, and the deterministic final-answer grader directly tests whether the agent recovered the curated conclusion, with trajectory rubrics used only diagnostically.
